title: Reversal follow-through: no clear chart winner
summary: The retained historical comparison does not establish a clear ES or NQ chart winner. Requested GC 20 evidence is missing; chart identity and timing remain provisional.

sections.title: Question and scope
sections.body: How does reversal follow-through differ across requested ES, NQ and GC Range XV chart sizes? This publication selects the historical full_v3 import because it retains expanded selection and excursion context, not because it is newer. The frozen selected candidates are ES 4 and NQ 10; GC 20 was unavailable.

sections.title: Supported findings
sections.body: Development leaders and validation-supported choices differ. The test-labelled saved comparison declares no clear winner. Missing GC evidence is retained as missing rather than replaced by available GC 6. The table carries null values and the saved recommendation for that gap.

sections.title: Definitions and methods
sections.body: A reversal is the first completed non-doji bar opposite the previous run; L counts additional same-direction bars after it. The primary threshold is at least three followers, excluding the reversal. Saved test labels cover August 20–September 4, 2026, after development June 14–August 2 and validation August 4–18 with embargo dates. Selected candidates are frozen before this test-labelled comparison. Saved 95% date-block intervals describe continuation; companion three-bar MAE/MFE is measured from the signal close in product ticks. Excursion extrema are separate, not executable exits.

sections.title: Limitations and uncertainty
sections.body: This is a historical import not newly revalidated research. Original short-export input files are missing locally. Filename chart labels are provisional Range XV, not verified Range XC; timezone, completion and session semantics are unresolved. Imported test labels do not certify pristine independent confirmation. Missing GC 20 prevents its chart-size comparison. Gross path extrema omit fills, costs and profitability.
